text:
anya: opened a PR to fix the /v1/predictions response examples in the API reference. current page shows `output` as a single object but runtime returns `outputs` as an array for multimodal/ensemble responses. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5120 :eyes:

kevin: ugh yeah that was an earlier shape. paste the bad snippet?

anya: current example on the page:
```json
POST /v1/predictions
{
  \"model\": \"vision+text-1\",
  \"input\": { \"image_url\": \"https://...\" }
}

Response:
{
  \"id\": \"pred_123\",
  \"status\": \"succeeded\",
  \"output\": { \"label\": \"cat\", \"score\": 0.98 }
}
```
This made a couple of customers think `output` is always an object. The service returns `outputs: [{...}]` to support multiple hypotheses and tool outputs.

mike: yep we switched to `outputs` last quarter. docs should show `outputs` array and mention that `outputs[0]` matches the primary hypothesis. also call out that `outputs` may include mixed types (text, embedding, json).

kevin: two fixes required: 1) OpenAPI response schema for Predictions must be updated to `outputs` array; 2) update the examples generator (all languages) to emit array responses in the reference examples. don't forget to update the example test fixtures.

docs-bot: lint failure when PR used old shape: components.schemas.PredictionResponse.properties.output not found; expected 'outputs' array. CI log: https://ci.redwood-inference/1700/logs/789 :warning:

anya: patched the OpenAPI YAML and adjusted the HTML examples. I added an explanatory sentence: "The `outputs` array contains one or more result objects; order is significant and primary result is outputs[0]." Also included a mixed-type example showing a text result plus an embedding output.

kevin: nice. please add a short migration note: older clients might parse `output` as a direct object; recommend updating JSON path to `outputs[0]` and provide a tiny helper snippet for Python/JS.

anya: added migration note and small helpers in both languages: Python `primary = resp['outputs'][0] if isinstance(resp.get('outputs'), list) else resp.get('output')` to ease transition.

docs-bot: CI re-run: linter passes after schema change, but docs-build failed due to stale fixture mismatch: tests expect single `output` key. See build 312: https://ci.redwood-inference/1700/builds/312 :x:

mike: i'll update the docs-tests to accept the new array shape and regenerate fixtures. also added a unit test that asserts the rendered page contains "outputs": [ so we catch regressions.

kevin: great. once CI goes green please open a tiny SDK issue to sweep snippet templates. i'll add it to the SDK backlog.

docs-bot: CI passed on branch fix/predictions-outputs-array (build 315) :white_check_mark: https://ci.redwood-inference/1700/builds/315

oliver: merged. small follow-up: update the examples index so search queries for "prediction output" land the user on the migration note. filed quick follow-up PR.

anya: thanks all  closing thread. :tada:
